# AES-SIV test cases with 512-bit keys (64 hex characters each for ctrKey and
# macKey) and zero or one associated-data item: the two call forms of
# Cryptomator (directory hash without associated data, file name with the
# parent's directory ID). Used by vault_task_siv_mode_512_cases (plan C1.2 (2)).
#
# Source: https://github.com/cryptomator/siv-mode
#   file   src/test/resources/testcases.txt
#   commit b8e0974036680520673e7a1d52979059e6952c6d (2026-10-05)
#   SHA-256 of the whole source file:
#   950b7272a566d1e1e49e1aacebbf59685eccfe5ee8afaa7cce9195736b2b0a5c
# Selection: the 640 lines whose ctrKey and macKey have 64 hex characters and
# whose associated-data count is 0 or 1 (160 of them carry one empty item).
# Lines are unchanged. Format per line:
#   ctrKey;macKey;plaintext;count;[associatedData;]ciphertext
# ciphertext = synthetic IV (16 bytes) followed by the encrypted plaintext;
# the RFC 5297 key is macKey followed by ctrKey.
